issues.legal_issue: Daughters of a coparcener are entitled to equal coparcenary rights by birth under the amended Hindu Succession Act, even when their father died before the amendment came into force.
A preliminary decree in a pending partition suit may be modified to give effect to a change in law before the final decree is passed.
A cross-objection may challenge the legality and validity of a compromise decree under the applicable provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure.
A compromise in a partition suit cannot bind parties who did not join in it, and must satisfy the requirements for a lawful written compromise.
An advocate cannot bind a client to a compromise without the client’s specific authority.
